title: deckback fidelity results
description: What `npm run fidelity` (harness/fidelity/run.py) measured: per deck x variant and per slide the V1/V2 pixel gates, the S1-S7 structural checks, the renderer noise floor (M1-R33/R57) and the known-unrecoverable classes (M1-R56); spec section 5. Private decks appear as sha256(file bytes)[:12] only, in the deck records, the noise floor and heatmap paths; a private PDF that could not be read is only counted (summary.privateUnreadable); no file name, path or raw tool message appears anywhere (M1-R55, M1-R58, M1-R62). A slide passes only when every gate passed: V1 null (no source PPTX) does not count against it, but an S check that is n/a or failed does.

relPng.description: a heatmap path relative to out/fidelity: ids and file names only, forward slashes, no drive, no ..

privatePng.description: a private deck's heatmap path: <12-hex id>/pdf/v1|v2-slide<N>.png

ids.description: M8: --ids picked this many decks of the sets asked for (the deck records name them)

offBarStructural.description: ruling M8-R1: real decks off the bar got S1-S6 only, with no renders (render and groundTruth reason off-bar, V2 not measured)

barOnly.description: M8 round 1c: the real decks off the bar were left out of the run (their crash and repair checks were an earlier round's)

merged.description: M8 triage.py merge: the real deck ids taken from a re-measure (--ids) of the same run

commercialMissing.description: M8 triage.py fonts: the commercial font families the measuring PC cannot have (spec 5.5); a slide that uses one is judged by S1-S7 only

recheck.description: M8 triage.py recheck: S1-S6 of the bar slides were computed again from the stored PDFs and outputs (S7 and the renders are the run's); skipped: bar decks whose output was gone

cloudFonts.description: ruling M8-R2: the names (never files) in the Office cloud font folder when the round began, from harness/fonts/cloudfonts.py: the fonts PowerPoint had downloaded by itself, which count as obtainable and are never installed a second time

rescore.description: ruling M5-R3: present when the file was made by harness/fidelity/rescore.py from an earlier results file: that file (repo-relative path, sha256), the S7 side input (path, sha256, the date of its round trip), and the converter commit of the renders, null with a note when the source results do not record it

visualError.description: the gate could not be computed (no render, a size mismatch, ...): a fail

positions.description: ruling M8-R12: per text line of the input page (pdf_facts.text_line_boxes order), the largest distance in pt of any glyph origin in PowerPoint's round-trip export of our PPTX (S7's export) from the input PDF's, [along, across] the line (null: no glyph of the line was compared); unassigned: glyphs that belong to no line. Numbers only. Absent when S7 gave none for the page (not run, failed as a whole, or another text)

residual3Lines.description: ruling M4-R11: the eroded residual with each text line of the input PDF free to move 1 px (metrics.line_residual); results before M4 Task 7 have none

shiftedLines.description: of them, those that took a shift other than (0, 0)

passRaw.description: V1's test on the raw residual3 (M4-R11 keeps it recorded)

noiseExempt.description: ruling M5-R1 (writing down M4-R13): the slide's own noise record (`noise`, v2 of the MuPDF render of the PDF against the PowerPoint render of the source deck) has residual5 over 400 px, the M3-R51 absolute limit; `pass` is then the slide's V2 status and `passMeasured` the measured one. px32_shift1 plays no part. Absent where there is no noise record, and in results from before M5

noiseFloor.description: the noise record's residual5 that noiseExempt was decided on

outside.description: ruling M8-R12: V1's own measures over the pixels outside the text-line regions only (residual3 eroded pixels outside; px32_shift1 as a fraction of the whole image), and whether they pass V1's own limits; absent without text lines and in results from before M8-R12

passMeasured.description: only on a noise-exempt slide: V1's measured status (residual3Lines and px32_shift1 against V1's limits), which `pass` no longer is

pass.description: V1's status: on residual3Lines where recorded (M4-R11), else on residual3; the slide's V2 status when noiseExempt

outside.description: ruling M8-R12: V2's own measures over the pixels outside the text-line regions only, judged by the same limits; absent without text lines and in results from before M8-R12

limits.description: M3-R51: the limits the record was held to: the noise floor's numbers plus 50 px and 0.6 % (basis noise), or 400 px and 1 % without a ground truth (basis absolute); absent in results from before M3-R51

index.description: 0-based page index of the input PDF (= slide index of the output)

label.description: the manifest's slide id (public decks with a manifest), else null

v1.description: null: no source PPTX, so no V1 (spec 5.1)

noise.description: M1-R57: v2(MuPDF render of the PDF, PowerPoint render of the source PPTX); never gated; null without a ground truth

passReason.description: ruling M8-R12: positions, the slide passes as position-verified (only V1/V2 on text failed, and PowerPoint's round-trip export puts every glyph within 0.25 pt along and 0.1 pt across of the input PDF, and the residual outside the text lines passes V1/V2 on its own); the raw V1/V2 stay as measured. Absent: the slide passed on its gates, or fails

pass.description: the slide's verdict with its font exception applied; null: not measured (M8-R1, an off-bar real deck: S1-S6 only), neither a pass nor a failure

fontException.description: M8: the slide is judged without what its font spoils. mupdf-substitution (M8-R3): the PDF page has a font with no font program, MuPDF's reference render draws a substitute, so V2 is left out (V1 where a pair exists, and S1-S7, judge it). missing-font (spec 5.5): a commercial font the measuring PC cannot have, so S1-S7 alone judge it. font-version (M8-R9): this PC has a font the page embeds in another version (installed or cloud font; nameID 5 or head fontRevision differ), so the source deck re-laid on this PC is not the PDF's layout and V1 is left out (V2 and S1-S7 judge it). Absent: none

origin.description: real decks (M8): where the PDF came from, from the tier-B manifest; only powerpoint-windows counts toward the bar. A tier-c deck: from the PDF's Producer/Creator; it is never in the bar (bar false)

bar.description: real decks: true when origin is powerpoint-windows

error.description: the deck was not measured: its input PDF is unreadable, encrypted or a stale export, or an internal error stopped it (exitCodes.input 3); no slides

s7.description: M5 Task 1: the deck's own S7 verdict (the round trip of the whole deck); each slide's s.S7 is its own page's. failedPages: the pages whose composition differs, present when that is all that failed; without it a failed deck fails every slide

exitCodes.description: 0 ok, 2 timeout (left running, never stopped), 3 error (reason powerpoint-busy when PowerPoint refused the calls: M1-R74); null: not run (render after a failed conversion; groundTruth without a source PPTX; render and groundTruth with the reason skipped-after-stuck after an earlier PowerPoint timeout in the run: M1-R74). input is reading the input PDF's pages and sizes: 3 with the reason unreadable, encrypted or internal-error (M1-R62), or stale-export when a public PDF is not the export its stamp records of the deck and manifest next to it (M1-R77)

reasons.description: fixed tokens, never a tool's own message

convert.description: the converter's own counts and the wall-clock seconds of the conversion; null when it did not finish

pass.description: slides that passed; an off-bar slide (pass null) is in notMeasured, in neither pass nor fail

notMeasured.description: M8-R1: slides of real decks off the bar, which got S1-S6 only

bar.description: M8: the bar-only summary, over the real decks whose origin is powerpoint-windows (absent without one): the slides the stop rule counts, their font exceptions applied

pass.description: all passes, the position-verified ones (M8-R12) included

positions.description: of pass, the slides that passed by ruling M8-R12 (passReason positions); pass minus positions passed on their gates

tierC.description: M8 tier C: the author's own real decks (set tier-c, private, 12-hex ids), measured fully and reported, never part of the bar (absent without one). origins: decks per origin (Producer/Creator); reportedOnly: always true

known.description: slides with at least one known-unrecoverable class (M1-R56)

exitCodes.description: deck x variant records whose step exited non-zero

privateUnreadable.description: private PDFs (or folders under corpus/private) that could not be read: not measured, never named, no id (M1-R62)

noiseFloor.description: M1-R57, per deck x variant with a ground truth: median / p95 (linear interpolation) / max of the noise record over its slides, and how many slides exceed, on renderer noise alone, the V2 limits of a slide without a ground truth, 400 px and 1 % (overV2; M3-R51: against itself the noise floor is always within its own limits). Before M3-R51 overV2 counted the spec's 50 px / 0.6 %

s7DeckWide.description: ruling M5-R3, only in a re-scored file: the deck x variants without a per-page S7 entry, whose slides carry the deck-wide S7 of the source results

v1NoiseExempt.description: M5 Task 1: per deck x variant, the 1-based slides whose V1 is judged by their V2 because their noise record's residual5 is over 400 px (ruling M5-R1; v1.noiseExempt)

averages.description: spec 5: averages are reported, never gated. The mean raw_px32 and px32_shift1 of V1 and V2 over the slides whose gate was computed (null and error records left out), over the run and per deck x variant; null where no slide has one

powerpoint.description: M1-R74: stuckAt is the PowerPoint step (render, groundTruth or S7 of one deck x variant) that first timed out in the run, null if none; every later PowerPoint step was not attempted and is counted in skippedAfterStuck (reason skipped-after-stuck; S7 n/a); busy counts the PowerPoint steps PowerPoint refused because it was busy (reason powerpoint-busy). Both make the run exit 1
